subjects.name: Wyciek hydrauliczny
subjects.context: Przycelowanie: uszkodzona hydraulika maszyny, utrata 1k6 PW na turę do naprawy. Symbol techniczny, nie rana.
subjects.request: ONE BROKEN RIGHT-ANGLE HYDRAULIC PIPE in side view with ONE LARGE OIL DROP falling from its open downward-facing end. Thick metal pipe silhouette, one stout coupling, ONE broad black inner channel cut, jagged broken pipe mouth. Drop is separate below with a wide black gap. Compact complete mechanical-leak symbol; no blood cells, wound, person, oil can, cog wheel, text or extra droplets.
